scientific_question: Can a separately persistent, content-addressable conjunctive trace preserve directly experienced relations on a frozen globally competent backbone while leaving nonlearned inference and remote fast-weight reassembly to the existing P_T channel?
core_hypothesis: The frozen seed-2101 fast-weight system already supplies global expected-rank-like assembly, while direct fidelity requires a distinct episode-local state that binds the normal pair cue conjunction to the encoded signed support evidence. A fixed shared tensor-product address and one generic-trained positive gain are sufficient if the missing computation is persistent local storage rather than another response correction or global learner.
mechanism_family: separately persistent content-addressable local conjunctive trace, distinct from tanh changes, scalar amplitude gating, response-residual mixing, relation lookup tables, and a second transitive learner
claim_boundary: This is a one-backbone, one-trainable-scalar development sufficiency test. It can establish a causal functional decomposition on seed 2101 but cannot establish population replication, a biological memory system, unique tensor-product coding, or end-to-end co-adaptation. A valid failure closes this minimal fixed-address local-trace candidate, not every possible persistent local mechanism and not the confirmed P_T global mechanism.
registration_timing: The contract is frozen after the valid v2.2 mixed negative closed low-capacity response-expression correction and before writing v2.3 code, adapting the local gain, constructing Liu controls, or evaluating any v2.3 condition.

frozen_backbone_contract.origin: final step-1000 v1 backbone produced under curvature_gate_pilot_v2
frozen_backbone_contract.reuse_only: Do not retrain or edit the backbone. Freeze every backbone tensor before local-gain adaptation and verify byte identity afterward.

execution_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for local-gain adaptation and neural replay
execution_contract.trial_input_transfer: one contiguous CPU-to-GPU transfer per trial
execution_contract.implementation_freeze: The v2.3 implementation, tests, and implementation lock must be committed after this protocol and before local-gain adaptation.
execution_contract.artifact_freeze: After local-gain adaptation, write and commit a separate artifact lock containing the exact gain-artifact hash before any Liu evaluation. Evaluation must refuse artifact, backbone, protocol, or source mismatches.
execution_contract.seed_subject_relation_or_trial_filtering: forbidden except the prospectively defined stable-omission retained-evidence mask

local_trace_equation.normal_event_input: At support and query step 0, split the existing passive input into its left and right cue vectors c_l and c_r. No item index or relation ID enters the local module.
local_trace_equation.normalized_key: k(c_l,c_r) = z / max(||z||_2, epsilon_key), with epsilon_key=1e-8
local_trace_equation.state: L_0 is a zero vector of cue_size squared entries; this is the scalar-value special case of L_0=0 and L_(t+1)=rho L_t + omega_t v_t k_t^T
local_trace_equation.write: L_(t+1) = L_t + s_t k(c_l,c_r), exactly once at support step 0
local_trace_equation.encoded_value: s_t is the existing signed_magnitude multiplied by the existing subject encoding reliability, read from the normal support input; thus presentation reversal changes both s_t and k_t signs and leaves the stored relation trace invariant
local_trace_equation.decay: rho=1.0 fixed; there is no learned forgetting parameter in v2.3
local_trace_equation.write_gate: omega_t=1.0 fixed after the existing stable-omission or attenuation bottleneck has formed s_t; no correctness, label, Liu statistic, hidden residual, or relation-specific gate is permitted
local_trace_equation.query: q_e=k(c_l,c_r) from the normal query step-0 cue input and raw local margin ell_e = L_T dot q_e
local_trace_equation.local_gain: lambda_L=softplus(raw_lambda_L) is the only trainable v2.3 parameter and m_e=m_v1,e + lambda_L ell_e
local_trace_equation.symmetric_logits: output_dual[class_0]=output_v1[class_0]-lambda_L ell_e/2 and output_dual[class_1]=output_v1[class_1]+lambda_L ell_e/2, preserving the v1 common-mode logit
local_trace_equation.global_off: For the P-off/L-intact condition only, run the frozen query dynamics with P_T replaced by zero and add the unchanged local margin; backbone parameters remain frozen.
local_trace_equation.forbidden_inputs: item index, Liu relation identity, H>A or F>A indicator, true query label, correctness, LOO state, posterior, subject identifier, c_res, human target, or any offline crossing statistic

local_only_adaptation.backbone: load the frozen seed-2101 checkpoint and freeze every v1 parameter
local_only_adaptation.task_distribution: the same generic sparse ranking distribution with the Liu graph and its rank-axis reflection excluded
local_only_adaptation.loss: mean generic query cross-entropy of the intact dual branch over all 28 query pairs; no Liu term, local-only auxiliary loss, human scalar, relation label, H>A/F>A indicator, c_res target, or transitive/direct query weighting
local_only_adaptation.control_training: none; all controls reuse the exact adapted lambda_L and add no parameter

conditions.original_v1_local_off: frozen P_T and v1 output with lambda_L ell_e set to zero
conditions.dual_intact: frozen P_T plus the naturally written and queried local trace
conditions.local_query_key_shuffle: frozen P_T and natural L_T, but a fixed seeded within-subject derangement of the 28 canonical query-pair addresses is used; orientation is preserved and the same map is reused for intact and every relation-LOO replay
conditions.global_P_off_local_intact: replace P_T by zero only during every query replay while retaining the naturally written local trace

estimand_contract.local_field: For each retained support relation r, subtract relation-LOO logits from intact logits on all 28 pairs in both orientations, antisymmetrize, and apply the complete-graph Hodge residual projector.
estimand_contract.direct_correctness: Multiply the Hodge residual on r's direct edge by the registered correct orientation sign.
estimand_contract.local_branch_influence: Apply the same intact-minus-LOO field construction to lambda_L ell_e alone. Report absolute direct influence on r and mean absolute influence over disjoint remote query pairs.
estimand_contract.remote_reassembly: For each retained r, average absolute intact-minus-LOO total-margin influence over disjoint query pairs and average within subject before bootstrap.
estimand_contract.third_party_reassembly: Use the gauge-invariant third-party relational potential-energy fraction from the registered assembly definition.
estimand_contract.double_dissociation_behavior: Report learned and nonlearned accuracy separately for all conditions; global-P-off/local-intact is the registered local-only behavioral condition.
estimand_contract.global_branch_identity: Report exact original-v1/local-off logit identity, qualification, fast-weight necessity, remote reassembly, query binding, and terminal expected-rank-over-MAP projection.
estimand_contract.behavioral_consequences: Report learned accuracy, nonlearned accuracy, overall accuracy, symbolic-distance slope, and coherent-error summaries for all four conditions; no human interval is a primary gate.
estimand_contract.residual_fingerprint: Without training or selecting on it, report relationwise local causal rescue including H>A and F>A, corr(|lambda_L ell_e|,|c_res,e|), and whether cells with the largest v1 residual need receive the largest local causal contribution. This is descriptive only.

competence_and_integrity_gates.backbone: The original-v1/local-off condition must pass qualification_v2 before the local result is interpreted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: Every registered source, implementation source, backbone checkpoint, gain artifact, and artifact lock must match its recorded SHA-256.
competence_and_integrity_gates.frozen_backbone: Only raw_lambda_L may change during adaptation; every v1 state-dict tensor must be byte-identical before and after.
competence_and_integrity_gates.local_off_equivalence: original_v1_local_off must reproduce ungated backbone logits and recurrent outputs exactly, with logit tolerance at most 1e-6.
competence_and_integrity_gates.orientation_invariance: Reversing a support presentation must leave s_t k_t unchanged within 1e-7, and reversing a query must negate ell_e within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.trace_replay_identity: Reconstructing L_T by the registered writes must be query-order invariant and repeated evaluation must agree within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.stable_omission: A relation whose encoded support value is already zero must have zero natural local intact-minus-LOO influence within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.shuffle_integrity: Every subject's local-query control map must be a derangement and preserve the full 28-key canonical address multiset; intact and every LOO replay reuse the same map.
competence_and_integrity_gates.common_mode_identity: Adding the natural or shuffled local margin must preserve the v1 two-logit mean within 1e-6.
competence_and_integrity_gates.control_parameter_integrity: All conditions use the same frozen lambda_L and introduce no additional trainable parameter.

primary_decision_rules.aggregate_local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and the dual-intact H>A direct-correctness bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
primary_decision_rules.learned_accuracy_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 learned accuracy exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.query_address_specificity: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus local-query-key-shuffle retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.local_direct_specificity: For the natural local branch, the participant-bootstrap lower bound of mean absolute direct influence minus three times mean absolute disjoint remote influence exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.local_only_direct_memory: Under global-P-off/local-intact, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for learned accuracy exceeds 0.55, the upper bound for nonlearned accuracy is at most 0.60, and the paired lower bound for learned minus nonlearned accuracy exceeds 0.10.
primary_decision_rules.global_off_remote_collapse: The participant-bootstrap upper bound for global-P-off/local-intact remote absolute influence minus 0.25 times original-v1 remote absolute influence is below zero.
primary_decision_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Dual-intact nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and its paired participant-bootstrap lower bound relative to original-v1 is no smaller than -0.02.
primary_decision_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Dual-intact remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original-v1.
primary_decision_rules.global_branch_preservation: Original-v1/local-off exactly reproduces v1, passes every qualification_v2 intervention and query-order rule, retains positive query-binding contrasts, and retains an expected-rank-minus-MAP bootstrap lower bound above zero.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.all_primary_rules_pass: The frozen globally competent system admits a causally separable direct-memory component: P_T is necessary for nonlearned/global remote assembly, while the content-addressable L_T selectively preserves experienced conjunctions. Freeze a separate replication contract before any 2102/2103 or new independent development seed; do not call the tensor-product implementation unique.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.local_rescue_without_double_dissociation: Reject the mechanistic candidate even if learned behavior improves: the local branch is acting as a second global learner or its causal specificity is insufficient. Do not count accuracy alone as support and do not begin end-to-end co-adaptation.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.double_dissociation_without_local_rescue: Preserve the selective-storage evidence but reject sufficiency for the Liu local-fidelity problem. Do not tune lambda_L on Liu or alter the frozen address after seeing the result.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.valid_local_or_specificity_failure: Close the minimal fixed antisymmetric tensor-product trace candidate. Preserve the global P_T mechanism and any qualified local-storage positives, then diagnose whether a shared learned support/query representation or a distinct persistent value transform is missing before registering another family.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.competence_or_integrity_failure: The mechanistic outcome is non-interpretable; repair execution on the same frozen backbone without changing equations, controls, thresholds, seeds, or scientific rules.
